name: Manipur and Mizoram
one_line: Imphal valley and Loktak Lake at Moirang in Manipur, and the ridge-top road from Aizawl to Champhai in Mizoram

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Manipur: Inner Line Permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Every Indian citizen from outside Manipur needs one. The tourist permit runs 30 days and costs 100 rupees, online or at kiosks at Imphal airport, Mao Gate and Jiribam Gate.

rules.title: Mizoram: Inner Line Permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: All visitors who are not Mizo need one, applied for online before arrival. It is also issued at Mizoram Houses in six cities and at named entry points.

rules.title: Mizoram: entry points that issue permits on arrival
rules.detail: The tourism site names Vairengte, Farkawn, Bairabi, Sairang rail station, Lengpui airport and Kanhmun. It gives no validity or fee; blogs quote seven or fifteen days.

rules.title: Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram: Protected Area Permit for foreigners
rules.detail: Re-imposed in December 2024 after about 14 years of relaxation. Foreign citizens need prior permission and a Protected Area Permit before entering any of the three states.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

source.title: Foreigners now require special permission to visit Manipur, Nagaland, and Mizoram

history.change: Mizoram's official tourism site gives this as the date the new rules for foreign visitors took effect.
News report that protected area rules were reinstated for the three states, ending a relaxation in place since about 2010.

source.title: Foreigners now require special permission to visit Manipur, Nagaland, and Mizoram

rules.title: Mizoram: foreign visitors register within 24 hours
rules.detail: The permit is obtained online before arriving in India. After arrival the visitor registers online within 24 hours, and the place of stay files a guest form.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

season.note: No road on this route closes by season; monsoon landslides damage the highways into Aizawl.

hazards.title: Manipur: United Kingdom advises against non-essential travel
hazards.detail: The United Kingdom's foreign office advises against all but essential travel to the whole state, citing insurgent groups, ethnic clashes, curfews and internet cuts.

source.title: Foreign travel advice, India: regional risks

hazards.title: Manipur: Canada advises against non-essential travel
hazards.detail: Canada's advisory, updated 24 September 2026, cites insurgent groups and ethnic tension, with violence since May 2023, curfews and disrupted services.

source.title: Travel advice and advisories for India

hazards.title: Manipur: visitor numbers have fallen sharply
hazards.detail: On 27 September 2026 the Chief Minister said tourist arrivals had dropped drastically because of ethnic violence and that visitors would not come without peace.

source.title: Ethnic violence hit tourism in Manipur, tourist inflow declined drastically: CM

hazards.title: Monsoon damage on the highway into Aizawl
hazards.detail: The Sairang to Kawnpui stretch was badly damaged by slides and erosion in 2025; commercial vehicles stayed off it from 4 to 9 August for repairs.
